unresolved.reason: Niue's live 30-day arrival-permit list names Portugal only as permanent residents, while all other travellers must apply before travel. Residence is not a passport-wide attribute.
The live detailed waiver list omits New Zealand, but the same page FAQ includes New Zealand. Separate Niuean-origin and permanent-resident passport stickers prevent choosing one route.
RMI's country-based exemption, diplomatic-ties arrival, and all-other prior-visa rule does not directly classify a Hong Kong SAR ordinary passport. Do not transfer a PRC nationality result.
RMI's country-based exemption, diplomatic-ties arrival, and all-other prior-visa rule does not directly classify a Macao SAR ordinary passport. Do not transfer a PRC nationality result.
The Immigration Division's live-linked March 2024 schedule lists Guatemala in both ordinary-passport visa-exempt and visa-on-arrival sections. It cannot establish one issuance point.
